tagline: Empowering Access To Justice In South Sudan
hero_eyebrow: Legal support for communities in need
about_story: The Initiative for Legal Aid was established to ensure that justice is accessible to all South Sudanese citizens, aligning legal aid with the empowerment of communities.

values.title: Justice And Equality
values.text: We believe in equal rights and opportunities for all.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We act with honesty, transparency, and accountability.

values.title: Service
values.text: We stand with vulnerable communities and respond with dignity.

mission: We work to protect rights, promote legal awareness, and support vulnerable people through justice-focused advocacy and practical legal assistance.
mission_title: Justice should be within reach for every person.
mission_text: We work with vulnerable communities to improve access to legal information, practical support, and rights-based advocacy that promotes dignity, safety, and long-term resilience.

mission_cards.title: Legal Awareness
mission_cards.text: Helping people understand their rights and the legal tools available to them.

mission_cards.title: Advocacy
mission_cards.text: Championing the voices of those often left out of formal justice systems.

mission_cards.title: Community Support
mission_cards.text: Building stronger local responses through dialogue, mediation, and outreach.

services.title: Access To Justice
services.text: We provide free and subsidized legal assistance, ensuring vulnerable populations have the support they need to assert their rights and seek justice.

services.title: Human Rights Protection
services.text: Our program focuses on monitoring, documenting, and advocating for victims of human rights violations while promoting respect for civil liberties.

services.title: Women And Children's Rights
services.text: We champion gender equality and protection for women and children, offering legal support and advocacy against gender-based violence and discrimination.

services.title: Peacebuilding
services.text: Our peacebuilding initiatives foster social cohesion, conflict resolution, and peaceful coexistence among communities affected by violence and displacement.

projects.title: Legal Empowerment Workshops
projects.text: These workshops equip individuals with essential legal knowledge to advocate effectively for their rights.

projects.title: Community Dialogues
projects.text: Facilitated discussions that aim to resolve conflicts peacefully and strengthen community bonds.

projects.title: Advocacy Campaigns
projects.text: Targeted campaigns raising awareness about human rights issues affecting local communities.

testimonials.quote: The support from ILA has changed my life. I finally received the help I needed to claim my rights.
testimonials.name: Amina L.

testimonials.quote: ILA's advocacy work creates real change. We are grateful for their dedication to protecting our rights.
testimonials.name: John D.

testimonials.quote: Through ILA, we learned our rights as women. This knowledge empowers us to stand up and make a difference in our community.
testimonials.name: Sarah M.
